subject: POC gate checklist: infra dependencies & owners (MAP milestone)
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@gridlytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: POC gate checklist: infra dependencies & owners (MAP milestone)

Rachel — thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I'm drafting the MAP milestone for the POC environment setup so everyone has clear owners and a target close date. Below is the working list of dependencies we need to clear to get the POC environment greenlit from a networking/security perspective. Please review and confirm items you own or need action on from Gridlytics' side.

POC environment setup dependencies (draft):
- VPC peering: establish peering between Gridlytics VPC (acct 987654321) and Redwood POC VPC in us-west-2.
  - Deliverable: Peering request + route table changes.
  - Owner (Redwood): Karthik Iyer
  - Owner (Gridlytics): Tom Lee (networking)
- IP allowlists / firewall rules: list of outbound CIDRs and any inbound management IPs for support access.
  - Deliverable: Confirm CIDR ranges and maintenance windows for changes.
  - Owner (Gridlytics): Rachel / Tom
- SSO / SAML: SSO metadata + test user mapping (SCIM not required for POC but helpful).
  - Deliverable: SAML metadata URL or xml, a test SSO user, and attribute mapping for email/roles.
  - Owner (Gridlytics): Rachel (IAM) / Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole
- Secrets & KMS access: approach to store customer secrets (do you want us to bring a customer-managed CMK, or should we provide a scoped Redwood key for the POC?).
  - Deliverable: KMS access policy and secrets ingestion plan.
  - Owner (Redwood): Aditya Rao / Owner (Gridlytics): Security contact

Target completion: 2027-05-20 (tentative)
Next steps I propose:
1) Rachel/Tom: Send the IP ranges + peering contact details and the SAML metadata link by 2027-05-05.
2) Karthik: Draft peering request template and route changes by 2027-05-07.
3) Marissa: Coordinate SSO test plan and validate attributes by 2027-05-12.
4) Aditya: Share KMS/secret ingestion options and template for access by 2027-05-10.

I've attached a short draft MAP (draft_MAP_v0.2.pdf) with these milestones and a bare timeline. If Gridlytics prefers a different target date for go/no-go, call it out and we can adjust.

Thanks — let's use this thread to track confirmations so the MAP can be updated into HubSpot + our Confluence POC page.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel@gridlytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@gridlytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC gate checklist: infra dependencies & owners (MAP milestone)

Thanks, Olga — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and owners from our side:

- VPC peering: We can open a peering request from our side. Our VPC CIDR ranges are 10.40.0.0/16 (prod-like) and 10.41.0.0/16 (staging). Prefer peering into us-west-2 where your runtime will live. Tom Lee (cc'd) is our networking lead and can take the exchange details.
- IP allowlists: For outbound from your side to our APIs we will need this range on our firewall: 34.208.12.0/22 and 52.12.0.0/18. For any support access please request a static jump host IP — we'll coordinate schedules.
- SSO / SAML: We host IdP on Okta. I can drop a metadata xml — will send the metadata URL and a test user within 24 hours. Attribute mapping: email -> user.email, role -> user.groups.
- KMS/secrets: Security would prefer we use a Gridlytics-managed CMK for production, but for the POC a scoped Redwood-managed key is fine if we get an access policy template. Our security contact (cc Tom for now) will want the KMS policy.

I've attached a completed networking_request_form.xlsx with the VPC/account info and a contact for Tom. We'll follow up with the SAML metadata shortly.

— Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Platform, Gridlytics

Subject: Re: POC gate checklist: infra dependencies & owners (MAP milestone)

Thanks — looping in some quick technical notes from the infra side after looking at the networking_request_form:

- Prefer peering to a single Redwood POC VPC in us-west-2 (makes routing simple). If Gridlytics prefers Transit Gateway instead of direct peering we can support that but need the TGW ARN and account-level permissions.
- For the CIDR ranges Rachel provided (10.40.0.0/16, 10.41.0.0/16) we'll add route table entries and ensure no overlapping prefixes with our POC VPC (10.50.0.0/16).
- Firewalls: to support management/debugging we'll need inbound rules from your jump host IP; please provide exact IP and allowable ports (SSH 22, HTTPS 443 for admin UI).
- NAT considerations: if Gridlytics expects egress to the internet from our side, we will NAT from the POC subnet. If you require source-preservation, we should discuss a dedicated NAT gateway or proxy.

Attached is a short peering-readme.txt with the request template I'll use when we open the peering ticket. If Tom can confirm whether Gridlytics will accept a peering connection or requires Transit Gateway, we can pick the right template and timeline.

Karthik
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
